Task 3.2 A: window=1024, overlap=0, split_mode=fixed. BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 has a 512-token effective passage-embedding limit (sentence_bert_config.json max_seq_length=512, tokenizer_config.json model_max_length=512, BertModel max_position_embeddings=512 - all verified against the cached model, not assumed). Verified empirically: SentenceTransformer.encode() silently truncates to the first 512 tokens (including [CLS]/[SEP]); the embedding of a chunk longer than that is bit-identical to the embedding of its first ~510-content-token prefix. This 1024-token chunk configuration is therefore NOT a lossless 1024-token embedding experiment - only the truncated prefix contributes to the vector, though the full chunk text is preserved in the chunk artifact for inspection.
